name: MakerspaceCT
summary: A large, professionally equipped makerspace in Hartford with extensive metal and machine shops, woodworking, digital fabrication and textiles.

operations.hours_note: Fri 10am–9pm, Sat 10am–6pm, closed Sun–Thu (hours posted as changing from 22 July).

sources.note: Superseded Google Site, recovered 2026-08-28 from its still-live sites.google.com address. Street address, website and descriptive text are transcribed from it verbatim. The logo is the space's own mark, recovered from the same page.
'CT Makerspaces Map' My Map attached to the superseded site. Coordinates are the 'MakerspaceCT' pin, transcribed from its KML, not geocoded.
Own site: 28,000 sq ft in the G. Fox Building; operating hours Fri 10am–9pm, Sat 10am–6pm, closed Sun–Thu.

gaps: address and coordinates come from the superseded Google Site and its map; neither has been confirmed with the space
capabilities are inferred from prose on the superseded Google Site and are not confirmed
